vectors.what: the published audit receipt (5bb85cfb..., 20,308 B) records branch, command, timestamp, claims=50, failing=0 - but NOT the branch tip it read
vectors.expected: a coordinate-audit receipt should pin ref_tip_read, so a re-player can check the same tree
